# AUTO-GENERATED Men-at-Arms scripted_guis — do not edit by hand
# One spawner effect per MAA key

### Huscarl Spawner
DI_huscarl_effect = {
	scope = character

	effect = {
		random_owned_story = {
			limit = {
				story_type = DI_misc_variables_story
			}
			save_scope_as = DI_story
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:DI_story = { has_variable = DI_pinned_char_var }
			}
			every_living_character = {
				limit = { has_character_flag = pinned_for_edit }
				save_scope_as = target

				spawn_army = {
					men_at_arms = {
						type = huscarl
						men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
					}
					location = scope:target.location
					inheritable = no
					name = huscarl
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			spawn_army = {
				men_at_arms = {
					type = huscarl
					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
				}
				location = root.location
				inheritable = no
				name = huscarl
			}
		}
	}
}

			save_scope_as = DI_story
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:DI_story = { has_variable = DI_pinned_char_var }
			}
			every_living_character = {
				limit = { has_character_flag = pinned_for_edit }
				save_scope_as = target

				spawn_army = {
					men_at_arms = {
						type = teutonic_knights
						men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
					}
					location = scope:target.location
					inheritable = no
					name = teutonic_knights
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			spawn_army = {
				men_at_arms = {
					type = teutonic_knights
					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value

### Insects Spawner

	effect = {

			}

		}

						type = insects

### Cockatrices Spawner
DI_cockatrices_effect = {
	scope = character

	effect = {
		random_owned_story = {
			limit = {
				story_type = DI_misc_variables_story
			}
			save_scope_as = DI_story
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:DI_story = { has_variable = DI_pinned_char_var }
			}
			every_living_character = {
				limit = { has_character_flag = pinned_for_edit }
				save_scope_as = target

				spawn_army = {
					men_at_arms = {
						type = cockatrices
						men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
					}
					location = scope:target.location
					inheritable = no
					name = cockatrices
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			spawn_army = {
				men_at_arms = {
					type = cockatrices
					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
				}
				location = root.location
				inheritable = no
				name = cockatrices
			}
		}
	}
}

					}
					location = scope:target.location

					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value

				name = fire_salamanders

### Mist Dragons Spawner
DI_mist_dragons_effect = {
	scope = character

	effect = {
		random_owned_story = {
			limit = {
				story_type = DI_misc_variables_story
			}
			save_scope_as = DI_story
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:DI_story = { has_variable = DI_pinned_char_var }
			}
			every_living_character = {
				limit = { has_character_flag = pinned_for_edit }
				save_scope_as = target

				spawn_army = {
					men_at_arms = {
						type = mist_dragons
						men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
					}
					location = scope:target.location
					inheritable = no
					name = mist_dragons
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			spawn_army = {
				men_at_arms = {
					type = mist_dragons
					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
				}
				location = root.location
				inheritable = no
				name = mist_dragons
			}
		}
	}

### Guardian Angels Spawner
DI_guardian_angels_effect = {
	scope = character

	effect = {
		random_owned_story = {
			limit = {
				story_type = DI_misc_variables_story
			}
			save_scope_as = DI_story
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:DI_story = { has_variable = DI_pinned_char_var }
			}
			every_living_character = {
				limit = { has_character_flag = pinned_for_edit }
				save_scope_as = target

				spawn_army = {
					men_at_arms = {
						type = guardian_angels
						men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
					}
					location = scope:target.location
					inheritable = no
					name = guardian_angels
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			spawn_army = {
				men_at_arms = {
					type = guardian_angels
					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
				}
				location = root.location
				inheritable = no
				name = guardian_angels
			}
		}
	}

DI_celestial_guard_maa_effect = {
	scope = character

	effect = {
		random_owned_story = {
			limit = {
				story_type = DI_misc_variables_story
			}
			save_scope_as = DI_story
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:DI_story = { has_variable = DI_pinned_char_var }
			}
			every_living_character = {
				limit = { has_character_flag = pinned_for_edit }
				save_scope_as = target

				spawn_army = {
					men_at_arms = {
						type = celestial_guard_maa
						men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
					}
					location = scope:target.location
					inheritable = no
					name = celestial_guard_maa
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			spawn_army = {
				men_at_arms = {
					type = celestial_guard_maa
					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
				}
				location = root.location
				inheritable = no
				name = celestial_guard_maa
			}
		}
	}
}

	scope = character

	effect = {
		random_owned_story = {
			limit = {
				story_type = DI_misc_variables_story
			}

		}

			save_scope_as = DI_story
		}

				save_scope_as = target

				spawn_army = {
					men_at_arms = {
						type = witchhunters
						men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
					}
					location = scope:target.location
					inheritable = no
					name = witchhunters
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			spawn_army = {
				men_at_arms = {
					type = witchhunters
					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value

		random_owned_story = {
			limit = {
				story_type = DI_misc_variables_story
			}
			save_scope_as = DI_story
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:DI_story = { has_variable = DI_pinned_char_var }
			}
			every_living_character = {
				limit = { has_character_flag = pinned_for_edit }
				save_scope_as = target

				spawn_army = {
					men_at_arms = {
						type = animated_tree
						men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
					}
					location = scope:target.location
					inheritable = no
					name = animated_tree
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			spawn_army = {
				men_at_arms = {
					type = animated_tree
					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
				}
				location = root.location
				inheritable = no
				name = animated_tree
			}
		}
	}
}

				limit = { has_character_flag = pinned_for_edit }
				save_scope_as = target

				spawn_army = {
					men_at_arms = {
						type = phantasmi
						men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
					}
					location = scope:target.location
					inheritable = no
					name = phantasmi
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			spawn_army = {
				men_at_arms = {
					type = phantasmi
					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
				}
				location = root.location
				inheritable = no
				name = phantasmi
			}
		}
	}
}
